advanced-filter-description: Mɔɖeɖe ŋgɔyiyi na mɔ be woaŋlɔ fli si me dɔwɔnadzesi siawo le: == != <= >= && || ( ) Wozã teƒe gbɔlo be woama dɔwɔnadzesiwo dome. Àte ŋu amɔ agble tɔxɛwo katã to woƒe ŋkɔwo kple asixɔxɔwo ŋɔŋlɔ dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == Value1. Dzesi: Ne teƒe gbɔlo le agblewo alo asixɔxɔwo me la, ele be nàtsɔ wo ade kaklã ɖeka me. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Be woatsɔ asi adzo le dziɖudzesi ɖeka (' \/) ŋu la, àte ŋu azã \. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == I\'m. Àte ŋu atsɔ nɔnɔme geɖewo afli ɖekae hã. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Zi geɖe la, woɖea dɔwɔnadzesiwo katã me tso miame yi nuɖusime. Àte ŋu atrɔ̃ ɖoɖo la to kaklãwo deɖe me dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Àte ŋu adi nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe agblewo hã to regex zazã me: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-deck: Tsɔ NextCloud Deck kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe JSON de afisia (kpekpeɖeŋu si me "stacks" le, stack ɖesiaɖe kɔa eƒe "cards"). Stacks atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye cards atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Tsɔ OpenProject ƒe dɔ-kpekpewo ƒe JSON de afisia (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Nɔnɔmewo atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔ-kpekpewo atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo.
import-board-instruction-issues: Tsɔ __sourceName__ ƒe kuxiwo ƒe JSON fli de afisia (__endpoint__). Kuxiwo atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo si woƒu ƒu ɖe Open / Closed xexlẽdzesiwo me.
import-board-instruction-asana: Tsɔ Asana dɔwo ƒe JSON si wotsɔ ɖe go de afisia ({ "data": [...] } tso Asana ƒe nuɖeɖego alo GET /tasks). Woƒu dɔwo ƒu ɖe akpa me (memberships); dɔ siwo wowu nu la yina Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Tsɔ ZenKit ƒe xexlẽdzesi JSON si wotsɔ ɖe go de afisia ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye items atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Tsɔ markdown dɔwɔwɔ ƒe xexlẽme pepa ɖo (mɔ si markdown-kanban dɔwɔnu siwo abe Obsidian Kanban ene zãna): "## List ƒe ŋkɔ" tanya siwo, kple nu siwo nye "- [ ]"/"- [x]" le woƒe te. Tanya siwo trɔna zua lisiwo eye nu siwo trɔna zua kaatawo; bullet list tsɔtsɔ si mele checkbox aɖeke ŋu o hã ge ɖe eme, abe kaata ʋuʋu ene.
import-board-instruction-leo: Kle Leo ƒe ɖoɖo (faɛl .leo) ɖe afisia. Akpa siwo le ɣome si kɔ wu la zu xexlẽdzesiwo, akpa siwo le wo te tẽ la zu agbalẽviwo, eye akpa la ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ zu agbalẽvi la ƒe numeɖeɖe. Akpa siwo le ɣome siwo le eme goglo wu la zu dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesiwo. Wotsɔa akpa siwo wode dzesi la va eme abe nu siwo wu enu ene.
import-board-instruction-opml: Tsɔ OPML ƒe ɖoɖo de eme, abe ale si Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq kple ɖoɖowɔdɔwɔnu bubuwo ɖenɛ ene. Nu siwo le tame zua xexlẽdzesiwo, woƒe viwo zua kaɖiwo kple nuŋlɔɖi abe numeɖeɖe ene, eye nu siwo le te wu zua ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo. Nu siwo wowu nu la vaa eme abe nu siwo wowu ene.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Tsɔ Org mode faɛl de eme, abe ale si Emacs, Orgzly alo Beorg ŋlɔnɛ ene. Tanya siwo le tame zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye tanya siwo le ɖoƒe evelia zua kaɖiwo. Wodzraa TODO kple DONE, nu vevitɔwo, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE kple CLOSED ɖo, eye dzesideɖefewo kple tanya siwo le te wu zua ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Kle todo.txt ƒe faɛl aɖe ɖe afi sia: dɔ ɖeka le fli ɖesiaɖe me, abe ale si todo.txt dɔwɔnu kple dɔwɔnu siwo sɔ kplii ŋlɔe ene. Dɔ siwo wu enu ("x") yina Dɔwuɖeɖi me, +project kple @context trɔna zu dzesiwo, (A) trɔna zu nukpɔsusu gbãtɔ ƒe dzesi, eye due: kple t: trɔna zu nuwuwu ŋkeke kple gɔmedzedze ŋkeke.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Te task export ƒe emetsonu ɖe afisia: JSON xexlẽdzesi, alo dɔ ɖeka le fli ɖesiaɖe dzi. Dɔ siwo wowu nu le yina ɖe Done me, project kple priority trɔna dzua dzesiwo, annotations trɔna dzua nuŋɔŋlɔwo, eye depends trɔna dzua kadodowo kple dɔ siwo le mɔ xɛm na dɔa.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ʋu .boardarchive ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe eye nàte kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe board.jsonl ɖe afisia, kple eƒe tɔtrɔ ƒe fli alo emanɔmee. Nɔnɔme si ƒoa nuwo nu ƒu ɖe ƒuƒoƒowo me le kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me trɔna dzua xexlẽdzesiwo, tiatia ƒe nɔnɔme bubuwo trɔna dzua dzesiwo, nuŋɔŋlɔ kple dzesidede ƒe aɖaka ƒe akpa siwo le eme trɔna dzua numeɖeɖe kple dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi, eye woléa nuŋɔŋlɔwo ɖe asi. Wometsɔa nɔnɔmetatawo kple kpeɖeŋu-agbalẽwo va eme o.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Le MeisterTask me la, zi dɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ dzi, tia Export project eye nàɖe CSV la, emegbe tsɔe de eme. Akpawo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, ŋkeke mamlɛ, dɔwɔla kple tags; dɔ siwo wowu nu la léa woƒe nuwuwuŋkeke ɖe asi. CSV si woŋlɔ na MeisterTask ŋutɔ ƒe nuxɔxɔ hã wɔa dɔ.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Le Obsidian me la, ʋu Kanban kpekpeɖeŋu la ƒe faɛl abe Markdown ene (alo ʋu .md faɛl la le nuŋlɔdɔwɔnu me), emegbe tsɔ ewo katã de eme. Mɔwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo kple woƒe kaɖiwo ƒe seɖoƒe, kaɖiwo léa woƒe tags, ŋkekewo, nu vevitɔ, agblewo kple ŋkuɖodzinudzesi ɖe asi, eye Archive zua kaɖi siwo le nudzraɖoƒe.
import-board-instruction-linear: Le Linear me la, ɖe nyawo abe CSV ene (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, alo nukpɔkpɔ aɖe ƒe ɖeɖe), emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, ƒuƒoƒowo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, eye nyawo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dɔwɔla, dzesiwo, ŋkekewo, nya dzitsotso, nu vevitɔ, akɔntabubu, dɔ kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe trɔtrɔ.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Le TickTick me la, ʋu Settings, Account, Backup & Import eye nàwɔ nudzraɖoɖo, emegbe tsɔ CSV faɛl la de eme. TickTick xexlẽdzesi ɖesiaɖe zua tsiƒuƒu eye eƒe ƒlowo zua xexlẽdzesiwo; dɔwo léa woƒe tags, ŋkekewo, ŋkuɖodzinudzesi, nu vevitɔ kple dɔviwo ɖe asi.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Le ClickUp me la, ɖe dɔwo abe CSV ene (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, alo List alo Table nukpɔkpɔ ƒe ɖeɖe kple ƒlowo katã), emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, ClickUp xexlẽdzesiwo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dɔviwo, dɔwɔlawo, tags, ŋkekewo, nu vevitɔ kple ɣeyiɣi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Le Nullboard me la, ʋu kpekpeɖeŋu la, tia Export this board... le nuɖoɖowo me, ʋu .nbx faɛl la le nuŋlɔdɔwɔnu me eye nàtsɔ eme nuwo de eme. Xexlẽdzesiwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye nuŋlɔɖiwo zua kaɖiwo: nuŋlɔɖi ƒe fli gbãtɔ nye kaɖi ƒe ŋkɔ eye esusɔea nye eƒe numeɖeɖe. Nuŋlɔɖi si womeɖo ɖoɖo na o la xɔa dzesi raw. Faɛl si me kpekpeɖeŋu geɖe le la tsɔa eƒe kpekpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ vaa eme.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Le Kanri me la, ʋu Import & Export eye nàtia Export individual board (alo Export all data), emegbe tsɔ .json faɛl la de eme. Ƒlowo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye kaɖiwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe numeɖeɖe, ŋkeke mamlɛ, tags kple amawo; kaɖi ƒe dɔwo zua ŋkuɖodzinudzesi. Le nyatakakawo katã ƒe ɖeɖe me la, wotsɔa kpekpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ vaa eme.
import-board-instruction-planka: Ŋlɔ wò Planka ƒe adrɛs (le kpɔɖeŋu me https://planka.example.com), wò Planka zãla ŋkɔ kple ɣaɣlanya, eye nàzi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi. Wozãa wo hena ŋɔŋlɔkpe la xɔxɔ ko eye womedzraa wo ɖo o. Tia ŋɔŋlɔkpe aɖe eye nàzi Xɔe dzi: WeKan xlẽnɛ tso Planka ƒe API me, kple eƒe xexlẽdzesiwo, agbalẽviwo, numeɖeɖewo, ŋkeke mamlɛtɔwo, dzesiwo, hametɔwo, dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo kple nuŋɔŋlɔwo, eye nàyi tsɔ va eme dzi abe ale si wòle ɖaa ene. Agbalẽvi siwo le Planka ƒe dzraɖoƒe la vaa eme abe esiwo wodzra ɖo ene; nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu kple agbalẽvi siwo le gbeƒeƒeƒe mevaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Le Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) me, ge ɖe eme, lɔ̃ ɖe Tasks.Read ƒe mɔɖeɖe dzi eye nàkɔpi token la tso Access token tab la dzi. Tsɔe da ɖe afii eye nàzi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi; wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ sia ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Tia xexlẽdzesiwo katã alo ɖeka eye nàzi Xɔe dzi. To Do xexlẽdzesi ɖesiaɖe zua xexlẽdzesi eye dɔ ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi, kple eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ kple gɔmedzeŋkeke, afɔɖeɖewo abe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi ene, ƒomeawo abe dzesiwo ene, eye vevienyenye gã kple nɔnɔme abe dzesiwo ene; dɔ siwo wu enu yia dzraɖoƒe. Ŋkuɖodzinuwo kple gbugbɔgawɔwo mevaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Le KanbanFlow me, ʋu ŋɔŋlɔkpe la ƒe menu, tia Settings → API & Webhooks eye nàkɔpi ŋɔŋlɔkpe la ƒe API token. Tsɔ token la da ɖe afii, zi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi, tia ŋɔŋlɔkpe la eye nàzi Xɔe dzi; wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ ma ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Ʋɔtruwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye mɔwo nɔa mɔwo; dɔwo léa woƒe numeɖeɖe, amadede, dzesiwo, ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ, dɔ suewo abe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi ene, ɣeyiɣi si wozã, ɖoɖo, amewo kple nuŋɔŋlɔwo me ɖe asi.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Ŋlɔ wò Basecamp akɔnta ƒe ID (xexlẽdzesi si le basecamp.com/ megbe le adrɛs la me) kple mɔnukpɔkpɔ token (tso OAuth 2 app aɖe si woŋlɔ ŋkɔ le launchpad.37signals.com dzi me, alo esi integration aɖe si li xoxo la tsɔ ɖi), zi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi, tia dɔwɔwɔ aɖe eye nàzi Xɔe dzi. Wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ ma ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Agbalẽvi kplɔ̃ ɖesiaɖe zua mɔ si ƒe ʋɔtruwo nye xexlẽdzesiwo, eye nusiwo woawɔ ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo zua To-dos mɔ; agbalẽviwo kple nusiwo woawɔ léa woƒe nuŋlɔɖi, ŋkekewo, ame siwo wode asi na kple nuŋɔŋlɔwo ɖe asi, agbalẽvi ƒe afɔɖeɖewo zua dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi, eye esiwo wu enu yia dzraɖoƒe.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Xɔ mɔnukpɔkpɔ token tso OAuth 2.0 Playground: le Tasks API v1 te tia tasks.readonly, zi Authorize APIs dzi, emegbe Exchange authorization code for tokens, eye nàkɔpi mɔnukpɔkpɔ token la. Tsɔe da ɖe afii eye nàzi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi, tia dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo katã alo ɖeka, emegbe Xɔe. Wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ sia ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua agbalẽviwo, kple woƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, kadodowo kple ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ; dɔ suewo zua dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi eye dɔ siwo wu enu vaa eme abe esiwo wodzra ɖo ene.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: Google Keep ƒe API la nye Google Workspace akɔntawo ɖeɖeko tɔ. Xɔ OAuth 2.0 mɔnukpɔkpɔ token kple scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (le OAuth 2.0 Playground me ne wò Workspace dzikpɔla ɖe mɔ, alo tso dɔwɔƒe akɔnta aɖe si si ŋusẽ le le domain bliboa dzi), tsɔe da eme, zi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi eye emegbe Xɔe. Wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ sia ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Nuŋlɔɖi ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo zua agbalẽviwo le xexlẽdzesi Nuŋɔŋlɔwo me, eye dodokpɔ nuŋɔŋlɔwo zua agbalẽviwo le xexlẽdzesi Xexlẽdzesiwo me kple woƒe nuwo abe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi ene. Nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo le gbeƒeƒeƒe, nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu kple mama mevaa eme o.
api-import-desc: Xɔe tso dɔwɔƒe la kple wò ŋutɔ wò akɔnta. Nu si nàŋlɔ ɖe afii la, wozãnɛ hena xɔxɔ sia ko eye womedzraa eɖo o.
api-import-list: Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi na nu siwo ate ŋu ava eme
api-import-fetched: Wòxɔe. Kpɔ hametɔ siwo le ete eye nàtsɔ va eme.
api-import-nothing: Naneke meli be woatsɔ va eme kple akɔnta sia o.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Le Pivotal Tracker me la, ʋu dɔ la ƒe MORE axa eye nàtia Export CSV (alo tia ŋutinyawo eye nàtia Bulk Actions, CSV), emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Ŋutinya ƒe nɔnɔme ɖesiaɖe zua xexlẽdzesi eye ŋutinyawo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe ƒomevi kple dzesiwo, tɔwo, biala, ŋkekewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo, dɔwo kple mɔxenuwo; Estimate zua Story points eye trɔtrɔwo zua sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Le Tasks.org me la, ʋu Settings, Backups eye nàtia Export tasks, emegbe tsɔ .json faɛl ma me nuwo de eme. Xexlẽdzesiwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, tags, ŋkekewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple dɔviwo; dɔ siwo wowu nu la léa woƒe nuwuwuŋkeke ɖe asi, eye nu vevitɔ zua agble tɔxɛ.
import-board-instruction-monday: Le monday.com me la, ʋu kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nuɖoɖowo, tia More actions kple Export board to Excel (kple updates kple subitems ne èdi), emegbe tia .xlsx faɛl ma. Status ƒlo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye ƒuƒoƒowo zua tsiƒuƒuwo; amewo, ŋkekewo, ɣeyiɣi ƒe mɔ kple tags léa woƒe teƒewo ɖe asi, ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo eye updates zua nyaŋuɖoɖowo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Le Super Productivity me la, ʋu Settings, emegbe Sync & Backup, tia Export Data eye nàtsɔ sp-backup .json faɛl la me nuwo de eme. Dɔ ɖesiaɖe zua tsiƒuƒu eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo le To Do, In Progress, Backlog alo Done me, kple woƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, tags, ŋkeke mamlɛ, ɣeyiɣi si wozã kple dɔviwo; dɔ siwo le nudzraɖoƒe zua kaɖi siwo le nudzraɖoƒe.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Le Taiga me la, ʋu Admin > Project > Export eye nàxɔ dɔ la ƒe nudzraɖoɖo (ʋu .json.gz faɛl gbã), emegbe tsɔ eƒe JSON de eme. Zazãla ƒe ŋutinya ƒe nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, zazãla ƒe ŋutinyawo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dɔwo abe dɔviwo ene, epics kple nyawo xɔa woawo ŋutɔ ƒe tsiƒuƒuwo, eye sprints, tags, nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple nɔnɔme tɔxɛwo hã vaa eme. Wometsɔa nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu vaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Le Vikunja me la, ʋu Settings, tia Data Export eye nàxɔ .zip faɛl si wòɖona na wò, emegbe tia faɛl ma, alo tsɔ data.json si le eme de eme. Kanban gazewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe dzesiwo, dɔwɔlawo, ŋkekewo, numeɖeɖe, dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo abe ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo ene kple nyaŋuɖoɖowo; nu vevitɔ, akpa si wowu kple wowu nu zua agble tɔxɛwo. Wometsɔa nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu vaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-quire: Le Quire me la, ʋu dɔ la ƒe nuɖoɖowo eye nàtia Export CSV, emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe dɔviwo abe kaɖiviwo ene, dɔwɔlawo, tags abe dzesiwo ene, gɔmedzedze, mamlɛ kple nuwuwu ŋkekewo, numeɖeɖe kple nu vevitɔ abe agble tɔxɛ ene. Nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu mele Quire ƒe CSV me o.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Le Wrike me la, ɖe dɔ alo faɛlgba aɖe ɖo Excel me, alo yɔ Wrike ƒe Excel nuxɔxɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu me, emegbe tia .xlsx faɛl ma. Faɛlgba kple dɔ ƒe fliwo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, Status zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe Key, dɔ dzitsotso, dɔwɔlawo, gɔmedzedze kple nuwuwu ŋkekewo, nudzidzedzewo kple numeɖeɖe; Priority, Duration kple ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Le Teamwork.com me la, yɔ Excel dɔ nuxɔxɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu la me (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) eye nàdzrae ɖo abe .xlsx ene, emegbe tia faɛl ma. Dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo; dɔ si dze egɔme kple -, # alo > la zua dɔvi na dɔ si le edzi (--, ## alo >> ɖoƒe ɖeka le te wu). Dɔwɔlawo, ŋkekewo kple tags léa woƒe teƒewo ɖe asi; Priority, Estimated time kple Complete zua agble tɔxɛwo.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Le Businessmap (si wona ŋkɔ Kanbanize tsã) me la, ʋu Advanced Search, tia Configure results be nàtia ƒlowo, xɔ Excel faɛl la, emegbe tia .xlsx faɛl ma. Woxlẽa ƒlowo le woƒe Eŋlisigbe ŋkɔwo nu (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ne wò akɔnta zãa gbe bubu la, trɔ tanya ƒe fli la ƒe ŋkɔwo wòazu Eŋlisigbe gbã. Column zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye Lane zua tsiƒuƒuwo; tɔwo, tags, ama, ŋkekewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple dzitsotso ƒe kadodowo léa woƒe teƒewo ɖe asi, eye Priority, Size, Type kple ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Le Redmine me la, ʋu dɔ la ƒe Issues, tia Also available in: CSV le xexlẽdzesi la ƒe te, tia ƒlowo (All columns, kple Description) eye nàɖee, emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. r-wrike-workflow-note: Wrike ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔ nye nɔnɔmewo ƒe xexlẽdzesi, ɖesiaɖe le Active, Completed, Deferred alo Cancelled ƒuƒoƒo me. Ðeɖe ŋlɔa kpekpeɖeŋu sia ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo abe ɖeka ene, si woyɔ ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu la ŋkɔ, le JSON si Wrike ƒe API trɔna ɖoa na dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔwo me: wɔ dɔwɔwɔ ƒe mɔ ma le Wrike me hafi nàtsɔ kpekpeɖeŋu la ƒe Wrike Excel ɖeɖe va eme, ale be woazã eƒe nɔnɔmewo. Nuxɔxɔ xlẽa JSON ma si nètsɔ de etame, tso WeKan alo tso Wrike ƒe GET /workflows, ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu si wotia me: nɔnɔme si si xexlẽdzesi mele o la zua xexlẽdzesi, eye se aɖe dea dzesi kaɖi be wowu enu ne wotsɔe yi Completed alo Cancelled nɔnɔme me eye be mewu enu o le Active alo Deferred me. Womate ŋu aɖe Wrike ŋutɔ ƒe automation sewo tso Wrike o.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Didiwo ate ŋu akpɔ dɔwɔnadzesiwo be woana didi la nu naɖi. Woɖea dɔwɔnadzesi fia to dɔwɔnadzesi ƒe ŋkɔ kple asixɔxɔ ŋɔŋlɔ si woma kple dzesi eve dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, dɔwɔnadzesi `list:Blocked` aɖo didi la ƒe seƒoƒo ɖe kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi si ƒe ŋkɔ nye *Blocked* me. Ne teƒe gbɔlo alo dzesi tɔxɛwo le asixɔxɔ la me la, ele be woatsɔe ade nyaŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dzesiwo me (kpɔɖeŋu `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - kaɖi siwo le kpekpeɖeŋu siwo sɔ kple *<title>* si woɖe fia
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi siwo sɔ kple *<title>* si woɖe fia
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - kaɖi siwo le tsiƒuƒu siwo sɔ kple *<title>* si woɖe fia
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - kaɖi siwo si nyaŋuɖoɖo si kɔ *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kaɖi siwo si dzesi si sɔ kple *<color>* alo *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - kaɖi siwo me *<username>* nye kaɖi ƒe ewɔla
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - kaɖi siwo nye kpekpeɖeŋu si wode na habɔbɔ *<name>* tɔ
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kaɖi siwo nye kpekpeɖeŋu si wode na ƒuƒoƒo *<name>* tɔ
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kaɖi siwo ƒe ŋkeke mamlɛ le *<n>* ŋkeke me tso fifia. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ ŋlɔa kaɖi siwo katã ƒe ŋkeke mamlɛ va yi.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kaɖi siwo wowɔ *<n>* ŋkeke va yi alo didi wu o
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kaɖi siwo wotrɔ̃ *<n>* ŋkeke va yi alo didi wu o
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - teƒe si *<status>* nye nusiwo gbɔna dometɔ ɖeka:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - kaɖi siwo katã le nudzraɖoƒe kple nusiwo mele eme o
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - kaɖi siwo le dutoƒo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo dzi ko
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - kaɖi siwo le ame tɔxɛ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo dzi ko
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - teƒe si *<field>* nye `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` alo `__predicate_member__` dometɔ ɖeka. `-` deɖe *<field>* ŋgɔ dia teƒe si asixɔxɔ aɖeke mele agble ma me o (kpɔɖeŋu `has:-due` dia kaɖi siwo si ŋkeke mamlɛ aɖeke meli o).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - teƒe si *<sort-name>* nye `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` alo `__predicate_modified__` dometɔ ɖeka. Na ɖoɖo si dzea anyi la, tsɔ `-` de ɖoɖo ƒe ŋkɔ ŋgɔ.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - teƒe si *<n>* nye blibo si le 0 dzi, si fia kaɖiwo ƒe xexlẽme si woafia le axa ɖesiaɖe dzi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Woate ŋu aɖe dɔwɔnadzesi geɖewo afia.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Woƒoa dɔwɔnadzesi siwo sɔ ƒu kple *OR*. Woagbugbɔ kaɖi siwo sɔ kple nɔnɔmeawo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` agbugbɔ kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi ɖesiaɖe si ƒe ŋkɔ nye *Blocked* alo *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Wokɔa dɔwɔnadzesi siwo me ɖe vovo kple *AND*. Kaɖi siwo sɔ kple dɔwɔnadzesi vovovoawo katã ko woagbugbɔ. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` gbugbɔa kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi *Available* me kple dzesi *red* ko.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Woate ŋu aɖe ŋkeke afia abe blibo si le 0 dzi alo le 0 te, alo woazã `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` alo `__predicate_year__` na ɣeyiɣi si li fifia.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Nuŋɔŋlɔ didi mekpɔ ŋɔŋlɔdzesi gã alo sue gbɔ o.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Le gɔmedzedze me womedi kaɖi siwo le nudzraɖoƒe o.

s3-force-path-style-description: MinIO kple dɔdzikpɔla geɖe siwo menye AWS o gake sɔ kple S3 hiãe.
azure-connection-string-description: Menye se o: zã kadodo ƒe fli bliboa le akɔnta ƒe ŋkɔ kple key teƒe.
database-migration-description: Sɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ-nɔnɔme ƒe nyatakakawo (nu sia nu negbe nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu kple nɔnɔmetatawo, siwo susɔa le agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ dzi) le MongoDB kple FerretDB v1 (SQLite) dome. Ele be nyatakakadzraɖoƒe bubu la nanɔ dɔ wɔm eye woate ŋu ayi egbɔ (mɔnu gɔmedzedze: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; trɔ̃ kple WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ne ewu enu la, ɖo MONGO_URL ɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe bubu la ŋu eye nàgbugbɔ dze WeKan gɔme (le Snap dzi: snap set wekan database=ferretdb alo =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Sɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nyatakakawo yi FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migrate-to-mongodb: Sɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nyatakakawo yi MongoDB
database-migration-confirm: Kɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ-nɔnɔme ƒe nudzraɖoƒewo katã yi __db__? Nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu kple nɔnɔmetatawo le agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ dzi metrɔ̃ o. Ele be yiteƒe ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe nanɔ dɔ wɔm.
sandstorm-migration-description: Ne WeKan le dɔ wɔm le Sandstorm grain me la, woasɔ eƒe MongoDB 3 nyatakakadzraɖoƒe xoxoa yi FerretDB v1 (SQLite) le gɔmedzedze gbãtɔ, eye woatsɔ nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu kple nɔnɔmetatawo tso nyatakakadzraɖoƒe la yi grain ƒe files/attachments kple files/avatars agbalẽdzraɖoƒewo me. Esia fia ne nusɔsɔ ma dze edzi kple disk teƒe nenie MongoDB ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔ xoxowo gale zazãm le grain me, eye ena mɔ be nàtu agbalẽ gɔŋgɔ mawo be nàɖe teƒe ɖe go.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Tutu MongoDB nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔwo
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Nusɔsɔ si dze edzi megbe la, nyatakakawo nɔa FerretDB me kple agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ dzi, eya ta woate ŋu atu MongoDB 3 nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔ xoxowo be woaɖe grain ƒe disk teƒe ɖe go. Womate ŋu agbugbɔ esia o.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Tutu MongoDB 3 nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔwo be nàɖe disk teƒe ɖe go? Wosɔ nyatakakawo yi FerretDB kple agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ dzi xoxo. Womate ŋu agbugbɔ esia o.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Wotutu MongoDB nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔwo, woɖe teƒe ɖe go
features-desc: Dɔwɔnu siwo WeKan naa be nàtia. Woɣla dɔwɔnu si wometia o tso ezalawo katã gbɔ. Wodzraa eƒe nyatakakawo ɖo eye mɔɖeɖewo metrɔna o.
feature-views-table-desc: Ŋɔŋlɔkpe abe agbalẽviwo ƒe kpekpe si woate ŋu aɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu ene.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalenda kple ŋɔŋlɔkpe geɖe ƒe kalenda.
feature-views-overview-desc: Xexlẽme, hatsotso ɖe ame si wotsɔ dɔ de asi nɛ nu, dɔwɔɖoɖo, nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe ŋɔŋlɔkpe kple ŋɔŋlɔkpe gã.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Gantt nɔnɔmetata kpɔkpɔ ƒe mɔ etɔ̃awo.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Nuwɔwɔ ƒe dɔ siwo susɔ, dɔwɔɣeyiɣi kpuiwo, ɣeyiɣi ma ƒe akɔnta kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kabakaba.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Dɔ siwo susɔ, dɔ siwo wowu enu, dɔyiyi ƒe ƒuƒoƒo, dɔwɔɣeyiɣi kple lalãɣeyiɣi, dɔ siwo wowu enu ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ, ɣeyiɣi si dɔwo lala, nuxetsinuwo, Monte Carlo kple dɔyiyi ƒe dzidzemɔnu bubuwo.
feature-views-map-desc: Agbalẽviwo abe dzesiwo le nɔnɔmetata si woda ɖo dzi ene.
feature-approval-required: Na dɔwɔnu siwo WeKan yeye tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu nanɔ tsitsi me va se ɖe esime dzikpɔla aɖoe dɔ me
feature-preview-admins: Dzikpɔlawo kpɔa dɔwɔnu siwo metsi dɔ wɔm o be woado wo kpɔ gbã
feature-pilot-users: Zãla siwo doa wo kpɔ eye wokpɔa dɔwɔnu siwo metsi dɔ wɔm o hã
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Zãlawo ƒe ŋkɔwo, mama wo me kple koma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Wodzrae ɖo. Womekpɔ zãlawo ƒe ŋkɔ siawo o:
card-field-visibility-desc: Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖoɖowo / Kaɖi ƒe agble siwo kpekpeɖeŋuwo ate ŋu afia. Agble si womede dzesi o la, woɣlaa le kaɖi ɖesiaɖe, kaɖivi ɖesiaɖe kple kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖoɖowo / Kaɖi me. Kaɖi ƒe nyatakaka alo kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖoɖo aɖeke metrɔna o, eye ne èdee dzesi ake la, kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe dzena abe ale si woɖoe ene. Agblewo ƒe ɖoɖo nye kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe ŋutɔ tɔ.
cards-loading-description: WeKan dea kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe kaɖiwo eɖokui: kpekpeɖeŋu gã (si le lolome seƒoƒo dzi) dea kaɖi siwo dzena fifia ko (infinite scroll) kple xexlẽme gbagbe, ale wòle kabã eye wòzãa ŋkuɖoɖo kple nyatakaka ƒe mɔ sue wu, gake kpekpeɖeŋu suewo dea kaɖi ɖesiaɖe na mɔ bɔbɔetɔ kple dɔwɔna bliboa. Naneke meli be woaɖo o. Dɔdzikpɔlawo ate ŋu ana mɔ nanye se kple CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) kple CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe ŋkɔwo.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Lazy kaɖi ƒe numedede nye dodokpɔ: kaɖi ƒe xexlẽlawo kple WIP ƒe seƒoƒowo sɔ, gake Kalenda/Kplɔ̃/Gantt nukpɔkpɔwo kple tiatia geɖe fiaa kaɖi siwo wode va se ɖe fifia ko. Gbugbɔ de kpekpeɖeŋu siwo le ʋuʋu ne ètrɔ̃ esia.
render-links-as-plain-text: Fia kadodowo abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe ene
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ne womɔe la, kadodowo katã (markdown kadodowo abe [label](url) kple HTML gɔŋgɔ <a href> tagwo siaa) dzena ɣesiaɣi abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe si womate ŋu azi dzi o ene le nuŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe ƒe agble ɖesiaɖe me (kpekpeɖeŋu kple kaɖi ƒe ŋkɔwo, numeɖeɖewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo, ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo, kple bubuwo). Esia xea mɔ na kadodo siwo ate ŋu ablu ame. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ, eya ta woate ŋu azi kadodowo dzi.
always-show-code-as-text: Fia code katã ɣesiaɣi abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe ene
always-show-code-as-text-description: Ne womɔe la, womafia nuŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe abe markdown alo HTML ene gbeɖe o: wofiaa nutoƒe bliboa ɣesiaɣi abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe ene le nuŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe ƒe agble ɖesiaɖe me (kpekpeɖeŋu kple kaɖi ƒe ŋkɔwo, numeɖeɖewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo, ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo, kple bubuwo). Esia ɖea emenya siwo woɣla — HTML nyaŋuɖoɖowo (<!-- -->), markdown kadodowo ƒe yiteƒe, JavaScript kple code bubu ɖesiaɖe — fia, ale code katã dzena ɣesiaɣi, womate ŋu azi dzi o, eye mele dɔ wɔm o. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ, eya ta wofiaa markdown abe ale si wòle ene.
disable-all-import: Xe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ vavã katã
disable-all-import-description: Ne womɔe la, woxe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ vavã ƒe dɔwɔnawo katã: kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ vavã tso WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea kple Forgejo, kple kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe evelia wɔwɔ. Woɣla nu tsɔtsɔ vavã ƒe menu tiatiwo eye dɔdzikpɔla la gbea nu tsɔtsɔ vavã ƒe biabia ɖesiaɖe. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-all-export: Xe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go katã
disable-all-export-description: Ne womɔe la, woxe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go ƒe dɔwɔnawo katã: kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go abe WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, alo yi NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, kple nusi wokpe ɖe eŋu ɖeka ƒe nuɖeɖego. Woɣla nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go ƒe menu tiatiwo eye dɔdzikpɔla la gbea nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go ƒe biabia ɖesiaɖe. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-import-avatars: Xe mɔ na nɔnɔmetata tsɔtsɔ vavã
disable-import-avatars-description: Ne womɔe la, womatsɔ nɔnɔmetatawo (zazãla ƒe ŋutinya nɔnɔmetatawo) ava eme gbeɖe o. Esia kpɔa WeKan JSON nu tsɔtsɔ vavã, Trello nu tsɔtsɔ vavã, kple nɔnɔmetata ɖoɖo ɖe gotagome dzenawo ŋutinya kpɔkpɔlawo ŋu le gegeɖeme (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2) gbɔ. Wogatsɔ ŋkɔwo kple nyatakaka bubuwo ava eme; nɔnɔmetatawo ko woadzo le ŋu. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-export-avatars: Xe mɔ na nɔnɔmetata tsɔtsɔ ɖe go
disable-export-avatars-description: Ne womɔe la, womatsɔ nɔnɔmetatawo (zazãla ƒe ŋutinya nɔnɔmetatawo) ade kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go (WeKan JSON kple CSV nuɖeɖego) me gbeɖe o. Woagatsɔ zazãlaŋkɔwo kple nyatakaka bubuwo aɖe go; nɔnɔmetatawo ko woagblẽ ɖi. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
anonymize-import-users: Ɣla zazãla siwo wotsɔ va eme ƒe dzenawo
anonymize-import-users-description: Ne womɔe la, WeKan JSON kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ vavã trɔ̃a zazãla ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ va eme ƒe zazãlaŋkɔ, ŋkɔ bliboa kple ŋkɔwo ƒe dzesi gbãtɔwo wozua xexlẽla ƒe teƒenɔlawo (user1, user2, ...), gblẽa eƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa @username yɔyɔwo (kple ame-si-bia / ame-si-de-dɔ agblewo) yeye le kaɖi kple nyaŋuɖoɖo siwo wotsɔ va eme me. Womadzra zazãla ŋutɔ ƒe dzenawo tso nutoƒe kpekpeɖeŋu la ɖo o. Nya "user" dzea ame si le nu tsɔm vavã la ƒe gbe yome. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
anonymize-export-users: Ɣla zazãla siwo wotsɔ ɖe go ƒe dzenawo
anonymize-export-users-description: Ne womɔe la, kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go trɔ̃a zazãla ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ ɖe go ƒe zazãlaŋkɔ, ŋkɔ bliboa kple ŋkɔwo ƒe dzesi gbãtɔwo wozua xexlẽla ƒe teƒenɔlawo (user1, user2, ...), gblẽa eƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa @username yɔyɔwo (kple ame-si-bia / ame-si-de-dɔ agblewo) yeye le kaɖi kple nyaŋuɖoɖo ƒe emenyawo me. Agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe go makɔ zazãla ŋutɔ ƒe dzenawo o. Nya "user" dzea ame si le nu tsɔm ɖe go la ƒe gbe yome. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
anonymize-account: Ɣla zazãla siwo wotsɔ va eme ƒe dzenawo
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Ne womɔe la, kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go trɔ̃a zazãla ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ ɖe go ƒe zazãlaŋkɔ, ŋkɔ bliboa kple ŋkɔwo ƒe dzesi gbãtɔwo wozua xexlẽla ƒe teƒenɔlawo (user1, user2, ...), gblẽa eƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa @username yɔyɔwo (kple ame-si-bia / ame-si-de-dɔ agblewo) yeye le kaɖi kple nyaŋuɖoɖo ƒe emenyawo me. Agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe go makɔ zazãla ŋutɔ ƒe dzenawo o. Nya "user" dzea ame si le nu tsɔm ɖe go la ƒe gbe yome. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-activities-description: Ne womɔe la, womede dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nyadzraɖoƒe ƒe emenyawo gbeɖe o, eye womafia wo le teƒe aɖeke o (kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe gbɔgbɔmenu kple kaɖi ƒe dɔwɔwɔ tab). Womadzra ame si wɔ nu kple nusi wòwɔ ƒe ŋutinya aɖeke ɖo o. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-notifications: Xe mɔ na nyanyanana wo katã
disable-notifications-description: Ne womɔe la, WeKan maɖo ŋudzɔdzɔ ƒe nyanyanana (le app me, email alo subɔsubɔ bubuwo) gbeɖe na dɔwɔwɔ ɖesiaɖe o. Woate ŋu agade dɔwɔwɔwo (ne womexe mɔ na wo le tame o); nyanyanana wo ko wotu ɖi. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-watch-description: Ne womɔe la, woxe mɔ na ŋudzɔdzɔ ƒe dɔwɔna — zazãlawo mate ŋu aŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu, xexlẽdzesi alo kaɖiwo ŋu be woaxɔ nyanyanana o, eye woagbe ŋudzɔdzɔ ƒe afɔɖeɖe tɔtrɔ ƒe kpɔkpɔ ɖesiaɖe. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
backup-description: Dzra Nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu, Nɔnɔmetatawo kple/alo Nyatakakawo (nuŋɔŋlɔ-nɔnɔme ƒe nudzraɖoƒewo katã siwo menye nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu alo nɔnɔmetatawo o) ɖo ɖe megbe. Wotsɔa .zip la yia nudzraɖoƒe si wotia la gbɔ enumake — ɣeyiɣi kpui ƒe agbalẽ aɖeke meli o — abe backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip ene, si me YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars kple /data le. Alilikpo nudzraɖoƒewo (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) zãa dzenawo si woɖo le woƒe nudzraɖoƒe tabwo me.
backup-scope-description: Mɔ̃ bliboa, alo Habɔbɔ ɖeka. Habɔbɔ ƒe megbenudzraɖoɖo kɔa eƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo kple nusiwo katã le wo dzi, si me kpekpeɖeŋu mawo ƒe nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu le — gake zazãla ƒe akɔntawo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖowo mele eme o, elabena habɔbɔ ɖesiaɖe ma wo. Habɔbɔ ƒe megbenudzraɖoɖo gbugbɔɖoɖo ŋlɔa ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu siwo Habɔbɔ ma nye tɔ ko dzi.
theme-override-all-tenants: Tɔtrɔ si wɔa dɔ na amedzro siwo katã
backup-schedule: Megbenudzraɖoɖo siwo woɖo le ɣeyiɣi dzi

Ewɔa dɔ kple megbenudzraɖoɖo si woɖo ɣeyiɣi na, si dzraa nuwo katã ɖo.
continuous-backup-enabled: Na megbenudzraɖoɖo si yi edzi ɣesiaɣi nawɔ dɔ le server sia dzi
continuous-backup-target: Nudzraɖoƒe si woaɖo ɖe (mɔ blibo, le disk bubu, nudzraɖoƒe si wokpɔna ɖekae le kadodo dzi alo rclone nudzraɖoƒe si wode kpe ɖe eŋu)
continuous-backup-include: Dzra nu siawo ɖo ɖe megbe
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (le ɣeyiɣi ma ke me, tɔtrɔ ɖe sia ɖe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: SQLite ƒe axawo (axawo siwo trɔ le ɣeyiɣi ɖe sia ɖe me)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (ɖoɖo si nàte ŋu atia ade kɔmpiuta me)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe mɔ̃ aɖeke mate ŋu awɔ dɔ le server sia dzi o
continuous-backup-base-every: Gɔmedzenudzraɖoɖo yeye le ɣeyiɣi ɖe sia ɖe me (gaƒoƒo)
continuous-backup-encrypt: Tsɔ kod ɣaɣla tsɔ ɣla megbenudzraɖoɖo la (AES-256-GCM)

Dzra kɔpi ɖeka ɖo: ne agbalẽ sia mele asi o la, womate ŋu agbugbɔ megbenudzraɖoɖo la ava eme o.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Megadɔ ɖe afi aɖeke o (nudzraɖoƒe si woaɖo ɖe la ko)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Nudzraɖoƒe le nudzraɖo tsesi la me
continuous-backup-fetched: Wohe agbalẽwo tso alilikpo la me

gcs-permissions-note: Na WeKan ƒe subɔsubɔ akɔnta xexlẽ/ŋɔŋlɔ mɔ le bucket dzi: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → wò bucket → Permissions → Grant access. Le "New principals" me, tsɔ subɔsubɔ akɔnta email la de afisia — "client_email" asixɔxɔ tso wò JSON key me — emegbe tia dɔdeasi "Storage Object Admin" eye nàdzra ɖo.

s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → wò bucket ƒe ŋkɔ (alo Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → wò zazãla → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → tia zazã ƒe nɔnɔme 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Wofiaa abe 'Access key ID' ene.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Mɔ̃ ɖeka kple Access key ID; 'Secret access key' dzena zi ɖeka ko ne wowɔ key la — kɔe le afi ma (alo Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → wò akɔnta → ŋkɔ si dze le tame (le Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name hã).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → wò akɔnta → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → wò akɔnta → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → wò akɔnta → Data storage → Containers → wò nugbagbe (alo + Container be nàwɔ ɖeka).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → dɔtaɖodzinu tiatia le tame → wò dɔtaɖodzinu ƒe ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → wò bucket ƒe ŋkɔ (alo Create be nàwɔ ɖeka).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Mɔ le WeKan dɔdzikpɔla dzi yi subɔsubɔ akɔnta JSON key agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe anyi (si wowɔ le ete). Zã esia ALO tsɔ JSON de agble si le ete me.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → wò subɔsubɔ akɔnta → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (etsɔa agbalẽ la ɖe anyi). Tsɔ eƒe emenyawo de afisia, alo dzra agbalẽ la ɖo eye nàɖo eƒe mɔ le tame.

email-recovery-description: Fli ɖeka na ame sia ame si axɔ gbedeasi. Di to zãla ƒe ID dzi. Womeɖea gbedeasiwo ƒe emenyawo kple xɔla ƒe email ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔƒewo fia o. Tete vie léa gbedeasi siwo li fifia kple siwo ava ɖe asi; yiyi edzi gbugbɔa agbagba dzem be yeaɖo gbedeasi siwo le lalamɔ la dzi ɖa fifia. Ɖoɖo ɖa nu tsitsi tutua gbedeasi siwo wotsɔ ɖe lalamɔ la dzi va se ɖe biabia la ƒe ɣeyiɣi. Ne ɖoɖo ɖa le dzɔdzɔm la, gbugbɔ agbagba dze le ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe. Womate ŋu agbugbɔ gbedeasi si ɖoɖo ɖa dze egɔme xoxo la axɔ o, eye ɖoɖo ɖa si ƒe emetsonu meka ɖe edzi o la ate ŋu adzɔ ake. Vodada siwo anɔ anyi tegbee kple gbedeasi siwo va ɖo agbagbadzedze ƒe seɖoƒe la anɔ anyi na numetoto. Agbagbadzedze ake le gbedeasi siwo medze edzi o ŋu dzea agbagbadzedze yeye gɔme eye wòléa tete vie si li xoxo la ɖe asi.

Ðee ɖa be xexlẽdzesi la nagate ŋu awɔ sɔsɔ: tɔtrɔ siwo wowɔ xoxo la nɔa anyi, womeŋlɔa tɔtrɔ siwo susɔ gbeɖe o, eye sɔsɔ si kplɔe ɖo gbugbɔa xexlẽdzesi la sɔna kple eƒe dzɔtsoƒe.

interrupted-import-heading: Kpekpeɖeŋu nuxɔxɔ siwo tɔ te hafi wowu enu
interrupted-import-description: Kpekpeɖeŋu nuxɔxɔ siawo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe tɔ te le mɔa dome - subɔla la gbugbɔ dze egɔme, alo nuxɔxɔ la do kpo - eye wògblẽ kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe akpa aɖe ɖi. Womate ŋu ayi nuxɔxɔ dzi o, elabena womedzraa eƒe dzɔtsoƒe faɛl ɖo o. Lé kpekpeɖeŋu la ɖe asi abe ale si wòle ene, alo ɖee ɖa eye nàgbugbɔ faɛl la atsɔ va eme. Ðeɖe ɖa ɖea kpekpeɖeŋu si nuxɔxɔ sia wɔ kple nusianu si le edzi ɖa, kple nusianu si wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu tso ɣemaɣi.

feature-views-column-sets-desc: Agbalẽvi ɖeka mawo le tsitretsiɖoƒe ƒuƒoƒo geɖe siwo ŋkɔ le me - le wuwu nu, vevienyenye, dzesi vevi alo nu bubu ɖesiaɖe nu - wotsɔnɛ tso tsitretsiɖoƒe ɖeka yi bubu me to hehe me.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Ɖaŋɔ ƒe menu → Sewo doa se siwo tso nusi amewo wɔna kple asi enuenu.
feature-board-summary-desc: Ɖaŋɔ ƒe menu → Kpuie ɖe nusi ame sia ame wɔ le ɖaŋɔ dzi le ŋkeke alo kwasiɖa mamlɛtɔ me kple nusi ƒe ɣeyiɣi va yi la fia.

feature-search-phrases-desc: Didi blibo se nyagbe abe "nye kaad siwo ƒe ɣeyiɣi va yi" ene gɔme.
column-sets-empty: Tsitretsiɖoƒe ƒe ƒuƒoƒo aɖeke meli haɖe o. Ŋɔŋlɔkpe ƒe dziɖula ate ŋu awɔ ɖeka: na ŋkɔe, emegbe nàtsɔ eƒe tsitretsiɖoƒewo akpe ɖe eŋu.

github-org-import-desc: Habɔbɔ alo zãla ƒe nudzraɖoƒe ɖesiaɖe zua eya ŋutɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, si wovuna le Board View / Version Control me: eƒe nyawo kple woƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, dzesiwo kple faɛlwo, eƒe ɖeɖewo, eƒe GitHub Actions dɔwɔɖoɖowo abe Sewo ene, kple eƒe wiki.

github-org-import-running: Habɔbɔ ƒe tsɔtsɔ va eme aɖe le edzi yim xoxo.
optional-apis-desc: REST API siwo le abe nyawo kpɔkplɔ dɔwɔnu bubuwo ƒe API ene, ale be woƒe dɔwɔnuwo kple scriptwo nate ŋu azã WeKan sia abe woƒe megbe-dɔwɔƒe ene: nu siwo wodzra ɖo la nɔa WeKan me, le WeKan ŋɔŋlɔkpewo dzi. Wotsi wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe va se ɖe esime wodze dzesi ɖe edzi le afii. Ɖeke mekpɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe mɔɖeɖewo o: client ge ɖe eme kple WeKan API token eye ate ŋu akpɔ ahatrɔ nu siwo ame ma ate ŋu akpɔ ahatrɔ le WeKan me ɖeɖeko. Wo katã hiã be WeKan REST API nanɔ dɔwɔwɔ me (WITH_API=true). Adrɛs si le ɖe sia ɖe te enye esi client zãna abe eƒe server ene.
optional-api-trello-desc: Dɔwɔnu kple script siwo woŋlɔ na Trello ƒe REST API (le kpɔɖeŋu me Trellinator) wɔa dɔ kple WeKan: ŋɔŋlɔkpewo, xexlẽdzesiwo, agbalẽviwo, dzesiwo, hametɔwo, nuŋɔŋlɔwo kple dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesiwo. Trello token nye WeKan API token. Ne èɖe agbalẽvi ɖa la, eyina dzraɖoƒe le WeKan me.
optional-api-jira-desc: Jira ƒe REST API v2 ƒe clientwo wɔa dɔ kple WeKan: dɔɖoɖo nye ŋɔŋlɔkpe (eƒe safui nye ŋɔŋlɔkpe ƒe safui), nya nye agbalẽvi (DEV-7), nɔnɔme nye xexlẽdzesi, eye tɔtrɔ ʋãa agbalẽvia. Didi xɔa JQL bɔbɔe: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text kple ORDER BY. Ge ɖe eme kple WeKan API token abe mɔxenya ene. Ne èɖe nya ɖa la, eyina dzraɖoƒe.
optional-api-github-desc: GitHub ƒe REST API na nyawo ƒe clientwo wɔa dɔ kple WeKan: nudzraɖoƒe nye ŋɔŋlɔkpe, nya nye agbalẽvi, kple dzesiwo, ŋkeke vevewo (dzesi siwo si nuwuwu ŋkeke le), nuŋɔŋlɔwo, kple ʋuʋu alo tutu abe le Ŋɔŋlɔkpe ƒe nukpɔkpɔ / Tɔtrɔ ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ me ene. Token la nye WeKan API token.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Gitea kple Forgejo ƒe REST API na nyawo ƒe clientwo wɔa dɔ kple WeKan le mɔ ɖeka ma nu abe API si sɔ kple GitHub ene: nudzraɖoƒe nye ŋɔŋlɔkpe eye nya nye agbalẽvi. Token la nye WeKan API token.
bots-none: Bot aɖeke meli haɖe o. Bot nye dɔwɔla si le wò ŋutɔ wò server dzi - AI dɔwɔla, CI dɔ, script - si ŋɔŋlɔkpe sia tsɔa agbalẽviwo naa.

webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhook siwo yina go mate ŋu aɖo adrɛs siwo le WeKan ŋutɔ ƒe network dzi o, ale be ame aɖeke mate ŋu atrɔ ŋɔŋlɔkpe ƒe webhook ɖe dɔwɔwɔ aɖe si le eme ŋu o. Ŋlɔ host siwo le network ma dzi siwo webhookwo ate ŋu aɖo la ɖe afi sia - Node-RED, nuƒoƒo ƒe server - ɖeka le fli ɖesiaɖe dzi, abe ŋkɔ alo adrɛs ene, kple port be woaɖe mɔ na port ma ɖeɖe ko. Naneke mele eme o: ɖeke o. Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe dɔdzikpɔlawo ɖeɖe koe ate ŋu atrɔ nuŋlɔɖi sia.
account-webhook-desc: Adrɛs ɖeka si WeKan gblɔna na ne ame aɖe ge ɖe eme alo wowɔ akɔnta yeye. Womeɖoa naneke ɖa o va se ɖe esime woatɔ dzesi nudzɔdzɔ aɖe le ete. Etsɔa nudzɔdzɔa, zãla ŋkɔ kple ɣeyiɣia; tɔ dzesi teƒe bubuwo ne xɔla la hiã wo ko.

email-bounces-description: Nusi WeKan wɔna kple e-mail siwo gbugbɔna: adrɛs si woŋlɔ gbegblẽ, e-mail ƒe aɖaka si yɔ, ŋuɖoɖo be ame mele dɔwɔƒe o, nyatoƒoe le spam ŋu. Ƒomevi ɖesiaɖe ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo le esi, eye wowɔa wo ne egbugbɔ zi nenema.
email-bounces-enabled: Kpɔ e-mail siwo gbugbɔ dzi le WeKan me
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Dzudzɔ e-mail ɖoɖo ɖe adrɛs la
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Adrɛs la meli o: ŋɔŋlɔ vodada, akɔnta si wotutu, domain si womenya o.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Mesu fifia o: aɖaka yɔ, server la le dɔ wɔm. Zi geɖe yome ko fia nane.

email-bounces-ses-description: Le Amazon SES me, ɖo Bounce kple Complaint ƒe gbedasiwo, kple xɔxɔ ƒe se na adrɛs si dzi WeKan ɖoa nu tso, ɖe SNS ƒe nyati aɖe, eye nàŋlɔ adrɛs sia ƒe ŋkɔ ɖe eŋu to HTTPS dzi:

email-bounce-invalid-topic: Ema menye SNS ƒe nyati ARN o.
email-bounces-providers-description: Ne WeKan ɖoa nu to dɔwɔƒe siawo dometɔ ɖeka dzi la, ʋu eƒe mɔ, na webhook ƒe adrɛs sia dɔwɔƒe la hena e-mail siwo gbugbɔ kple nyatoƒoe le spam ŋu ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo, eye nàtsɔ safui si wòtsɔ dea asi wo te, alo ɣaɣlanya si nède adrɛs la me abe https://user:password@… alo ?secret=… ene la ade afisia
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Dɔwɔƒe si ŋu woʋu la hiã eƒe asidesi safui alo ɣaɣlanya.
activity-pub-enabled: Dukɔ blibo ƒe ŋɔŋlɔkpewo ɖea woƒe agbalẽvi dɔwɔwɔwo fiana le fediverse dzi (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Etsi le gɔmedzedze ɖoɖo nu. Ne èdze eŋu la, ame ate ŋu adze dukɔ blibo ƒe ŋɔŋlɔkpe ɖesiaɖe yome tso Mastodon kple fediverse ƒe sɛva bubuwo dzi abe @board-<id> ene le WeKan sia ƒe adrɛs dzi, eye agbalẽvi ƒe dɔwɔwɔ yeyewo ɖoa eyomedzelawo gbɔ. Exlẽxlẽ ko wònye: naneke si fediverse ƒe sɛva ɖo ɖa matrɔ ŋɔŋlɔkpe aɖeke o, eye womeɖea ame ŋutɔ tɔ ŋɔŋlɔkpewo fiana gbeɖe o.
caldav-sync-desc: Tsɔ ŋɔŋlɔkpe sia ƒe agbalẽviwo ƒe ŋkeke mamlɛtɔwo de kalenda me - Nextcloud Calendar alo CalDAV kalenda ɖesiaɖe. Ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ si woʋu le kalenda me la gbɔna agbalẽvi la dzi. Zã dɔwɔnu ƒe ɣaɣlanya, menye wò ŋutɔ tɔ o.
caldav-enabled: Wɔ ŋkeke mamlɛtɔwo ɖeka kple kalenda sia
caldav-invalid-url: Ele be kalenda ƒe adrɛs nanye http:// alo https:// adrɛs, si me zãla ƒe ŋkɔ alo ɣaɣlanya aɖeke mele o.
caldav-not-linked: Gbã la, dzra kalenda ƒe adrɛs ɖo eye nàdze ɖekawɔwɔ gɔme.
webdav-storage-description: Dzra nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu ɖo ɖe fɔlda aɖe me le WebDAV sɛva dzi - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud alo bubu ɖesiaɖe. Zã dɔwɔnu ƒe ɣaɣlanya si wowɔ na WeKan. Woate ŋu azã sɛva si le WeKan ŋutɔ ƒe kadodo dzi le afii, elabena nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe dɔdzikpɔla koe ɖoa adrɛs sia.
sqrl-desc: Wotsi enu le gɔmedzedzea me. Ne wodee la, gedeemeƒe la naa SQRL, eye hametɔwo tsɔa woƒe SQRL dzesi kpena ɖe eŋu le Hametɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo me gbã. SQRL hiã be WeKan nanɔ https:// adrɛs dzi.
sqrl-scan: Tsɔ wò SQRL dɔwɔnu lé kɔda la ƒe nɔnɔme, alo ʋu wò SQRL dɔwɔnu le mɔ̃ sia dzi.
sqrl-expired: SQRL kɔda sia ƒe ɣeyiɣi va yi. Gadze egɔme ake.
sqrl-sign-in-failed: Gedeeme kple SQRL mewɔ dɔ o.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL hiã be WeKan nanɔ https:// adrɛs dzi.
sqrl-description: Ge ɖe eme kple wò SQRL dzesi ɖe ɣaɣlanya teƒe. Tsɔe kpe ɖe eŋu le afi sia zi ɖeka kple wò SQRL dɔwɔnu; àte ŋu aɖee ɖa le afi sia ɣesiaɣi.
sqrl-add: Tsɔ nye SQRL dzesi kpe ɖe eŋu
sqrl-added: Wotsɔ wò SQRL dzesi kpe ɖe eŋu.
sqrl-none: Womtsɔ SQRL dzesi aɖeke kpe ɖe eŋu o.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Wotsi gedeeme kple SQRL nu na akɔnta sia tso wò SQRL dɔwɔnu me. Gade eme le afi ma kple wò ɖeɖekɔda.
sqrl-only-on: Wò SQRL dɔwɔnu tu akɔnta sia ɖe SQRL ŋu: wogbe mɔ bubu ɖe sia ɖe si dzi woato age ɖe eme.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Wò SQRL dɔwɔnu tu akɔnta sia sesĩe: wogbe ɣaɣlanya gbugbɔgaɖoɖo kple e-mail tɔtrɔ.
sqrl-only: Akɔnta sia gea eme kple SQRL ko.
sqrl-hardlock: Wotu akɔnta sia ɖe SQRL ŋu: womate ŋu agbugbɔe ava alo atrɔe le mɔ bubu aɖeke nu o.
